paired_residual.note: Paired by episode: the same 31 windows, the registered five drivers' residual share (the published development record, unchanged) against the nine drivers' (this record). Intervals are the method's: a distribution-free 90% interval on a median, a Wilson 90% interval on a count of episodes, which treat the episodes as independent and so are, if anything, too narrow.

episodes.reason: an input of the window is missing or the window is incomplete

not_a_verdict: Development evidence only (measurement-protocol.md section 1; repo-market-model#640). It confirms nothing, adopts nothing and registers nothing.

null.construction: N1: the driver-free spread, resampled by the stationary bootstrap, picked with the parent's onset rule

record: H10 second declaration, step 2: the nine-driver development attribution, beside the registered method

report_window.statement: No development episode meets the 2027-06-30 break: development ends at the parent's development end, long before it, so `sofr_volume` and `sofr_p99_p1_bp` are read on every episode and the break's refusal (`h10_drivers_2.break_refusal`) applies to none. The 11-panel-day report window is a property of this declaration (docs/decisions/h10-method-2.md section 5, fails public 11 panel days after an onset); it is not tested on development data.
